v0.1.0.description:
First release, for Leaf it Alone Steam build 26351512 (game version v1.1.3). See the README for setup.

No seed has been played from start to goal yet. If you get stuck, open an issue and attach `lia_ap.log` from the game folder.
v0.1.0.title: v0.1.0

v0.1.1.description:
Logic fixes, so generate new seeds with this apworld. `version.dll` has no functional change.

- Sakura starts in Statues only. Fountain now needs the Park.
- Hometown: the shop and the Shed building are open from the start. Garage, Basement and Swings need Sprint. `Key: Shed` opens the roof and the area beside the Shed.
- Castle: Armory, Library, Ring Bell and Put Books now need Dinette.
- Spin All Pinwheels needs the Leaf Blower.
- Dump Preset Leaf Bags needs Dog Run. Light Up Lanterns needs the inner gardens.

No seed has been played from start to goal yet. If you get stuck, open an issue and attach `lia_ap.log` from the game folder.
v0.1.1.title: v0.1.1

v0.1.2.description:
Needs Leaf it Alone **Steam build 26384472** (`v1.1.4` in the corner of the main menu). Replace both `version.dll` and the apworld. The v0.1.1 `version.dll` turns itself off on this build.

- Steam build 26384472 support. Game data didn't change, so item and location IDs are the same.
- Hometown: the Shed's leaves only move once the Garage is open, so the Shed now needs Sprint as well as `Key: Shed`. Before this, a seed could put Sprint behind Shed leaves you couldn't pick up.

Seeds generated with v0.1.1 keep their old item placement. If you're stuck in the Shed without Sprint, run `!hint Ability: Sprint` to see where it is.

No seed has been played from start to goal yet. If you get stuck, open an issue and attach `lia_ap.log` from the game folder.
v0.1.2.title: v0.1.2

v0.1.2r2.description:
Needs Leaf it Alone **Steam build 26453016** (`v1.1.7` in the corner of the main menu). Older `version.dll` files turn themselves off on this build.

- Steam build 26453016 support. Only `version.dll` changed. If you already have the v0.1.2 apworld, you can keep it.
- The game made the Sakura upgrades cheaper, so Sakura now has 10 Money Bundles instead of 11. Item and location IDs are the same.
- Hometown: the Shed's leaves only move once the Garage is open, so the Shed now needs Sprint as well as `Key: Shed`. Before this, a seed could put Sprint behind Shed leaves you couldn't pick up.

Seeds generated with v0.1.1 keep their old item placement. If you're stuck in the Shed without Sprint, run `!hint Ability: Sprint` to see where it is.

No seed has been played from start to goal yet. If you get stuck, open an issue and attach `lia_ap.log` from the game folder.
v0.1.2r2.title: v0.1.2

v0.1.3.description:
Needs Leaf it Alone **Steam build 26453016** (`v1.1.7` in the corner of the main menu).

- Sakura: a received Mini Tractor now appears beside the tractor shop. Before this it appeared next to you, which at the start of the level is behind walls the tractor can't drive through, so it wouldn't move. In Hometown and Castle it still appears next to you.
- The tractor in the Sakura shop stays there for its shop check.
- Item and location IDs are the same. Rooms generated with v0.1.2 keep working, and the apworld only changed its version number, so you can keep the v0.1.2 apworld. Replace `version.dll`.

If your Sakura save already has a stuck tractor, this doesn't move it, because the mod only places a tractor once per save.

No seed has been played from start to goal yet. If you get stuck, open an issue and attach `lia_ap.log` from the game folder.
v0.1.3.title: v0.1.3
